dispute_ticket.description: The driver pressed 'arrived' but he was never at Westgate. I was standing at the Gateway Drive pick-up point the whole time and the map showed his car parked about 600m away, not moving. I messaged him twice and called him, no answer. Then he cancelled and I got charged $6.61 for a no-show. I was there, he wasn't. Please refund the fee.

chat_logs.content: Hi, I'm at the Gateway Drive pick-up point outside Westgate. App says you've arrived but I don't see you?
Your car on the map is not at Westgate, it's quite far away. Are you coming?
Outgoing call to driver — not answered (rang 30s, no response).
Hello?? I'm still here at the pick-up point.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $6.61 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-6030 booked on-demand RydeX trip TRIP-2026-33951 from Westgate (Gateway Drive pick-up point) to NTU Hall of Residence 2. Estimated pickup 18:26. Payment: card.
Driver D-5874 (Hafiz bin Osman, Hyundai Ioniq SLA 6638 B) assigned. ETA 6 min.
Driver started navigating to pickup location. Live tracking enabled.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Driver GPS 630m from pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Arrival not auto-confirmed (outside pickup geofence).
Free wait timer started. 3 min free wait period ends at 18:28:30.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Free 3-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded. Cancellation fee now applicable per policy.
Driver cancelled 4 min 40 s after tapping 'I'm Here' (rider_no_show). Driver GPS still 630m from pickup point. $6.61 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (card).
Driver D-5874 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).
